rulings.ruling: Ruling: model error; f1040s3 line 2: "Credit for child and dependent care expenses from Form 2441, line 11. Attach Form 2441", and i2441 p. 2, Who Can Take the Credit: "You can take the credit or the exclusion if all five of the following apply ... 2. The care was provided so you (or your spouse if filing jointly) could work or look for work". A filer with no care expenses takes no credit and needs no Part II of Form 2441; the project guards on f2441.care. The candidate copies f2441.line11 on every return, so it needs the care-provider roster and the credit-limit computation from filers with no care. Triage executable-triage-v1 (triage/s3.json): 349 of 1,743 agree; 652 candidate-unknown records stop on the $dcprov roster with no care claimed (classm.asset.1, classm.f4952.1, classm.f8995.2, project $0.00); 742 candidate-refuses are gates reached through Form 2441's credit limit or Part III (classm.w2.1.deepseek: f2441.line14_bad, which the project also reaches through Form 1040 line 1e and so refuses the return; classm.asset.2: sales digital; classm.asset.4: ftc.needs1116; classm.carloan.1: sb.form8938), returns the project refuses elsewhere or computes without needing those answers for this line. No value differences. i2441 was not among the pages given (f1040s3, f1040, i1040gi pp. 14, 117), but the published interface offers f2441.care, whose question states the condition, so the guard was expressible: not an interface gap. Project stands.

Ruling: model error; f1040s3 line 5a: "Residential clean energy credit from Form 5695, line 15", and i5695 p. 1, Who Can Take the Credits: "You may be able to take the credits if you made energy saving improvements to your home located in the United States in 2025". With no qualifying property or improvements, the credit is zero and Form 5695 is not needed; the project guards on f5695.part1_any. The candidate copies f5695.line15 on every return, so it needs Form 5695 answers (f5695.business_use and others) and its tax-limit computation from filers with no such property. Triage executable-triage-v1 (triage/s3.json): 229 of 1,743 agree; 713 candidate-unknown records stop on f5695.business_use (classm.f2441.1.deepseek to .6.deepseek recorded, project $0.00); 801 candidate-refuses are gates reached through the credit limit's tax computation or dependent lines (classm.w2.1.deepseek: f2441.line14_bad; classm.asset.2: sales digital; classm.asset.3: sb.unsupported; classm.asset.1: a dependent's multiple_support), which the candidate reaches only because it evaluates Form 5695 for every filer. No value differences. i5695 was not among the pages given, but the published interface offers f5695.part1_any, whose question states the condition, so the guard was expressible: not an interface gap. Project stands.
